snippet.title: AALIYAH ON THE SET OF ROMEO MUST DIE 2001
snippet.description:
The filming of "Romeo Must Die" starring Aaliyah took place primarily in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada, with principal photography running from May 3, 1999, to July 23, 1999. While the movie is set in Oakland, California, most of the filming was done elsewhere. The soundtrack recording sessions occurred between May 1999 and January 2000.
Aaliyah sadly passed away on August 25 2001 in a plane crash. This was to be her second to last movie which opened to critical acclaim and showed how diverse Aaliyah was as an actress as well as an accomplished singer and dancer.

MICHAEL JACKSON IS CROWNED KING IN AFRICA 1992😮🤴
snippet.description:
Michael Jackson was officially crowned "King Sani" on February 12, 1992, in the village of Krindjabo, Ivory Coast. 

The ceremony took place during his goodwill visit to Africa. 

Elaboration:
The coronation was a symbolic event where Jackson was recognized as a royal figure by the Agni people of the Sanwi kingdom. He was presented with the title "King Sani" by tribal chief Nana Amon N'Djafolk IV. The ceremony included blessings, traditional attire, and him sitting on a golden throne under a sacred tree. Jackson also received heartfelt thanks in both French and English ❤️🤴
